scope: Read-only inspection of saved W01 r2 histories and cell data. No solver launch, API attachment, active controller edit, process-affinity change or guard change.
conclusion: A rapidly growing low-density air jet in the unforced core crossed the unchanged 50 m/s speed guard. The saved 0.668 s checkpoint precedes that growth and supports a controlled half-timestep short diagnostic. This is not evidence of a cured mass-balance problem or accepted wave forces.

observed_failure.locality: The jet is at x≈−3.86 m in core −15..25 m, upstream of the foil and remote from the outlet. This location differs from the old no-foil outlet failures.
observed_failure.chronology: Whole-domain maximum remains about 22.6 m/s through 1.03 s, first exceeds 25 at 1.041, 30 at 1.049, 40 at 1.057, reaches 49.9096 at 1.063 and 51.7866 at 1.064.
observed_failure.history_terminal_semantics: The guard triggers before the failing step is appended to history.csv/native_phase_budget.csv. Their last row at 1.063 is valid as a pre-guard row, not as the terminal physical time. completed.json and final spatial exports establish 1.064.
observed_failure.field_use: final.sim and final fields are preserved diagnostic evidence only; do not continue these guard-failed fields.

cfl_distinctions.interpretation: Global maximum CFL, interface maximum CFL, and maximum speed occur in different cells. Interface maxima are near the original mesh/inlet-extension join at x≈−11.9, while the air jet occurs near −3.86. Spatial separation does not prove causation or independence.
cfl_distinctions.halfdt_limit: For frozen velocity and geometry, halving dt halves convective CFL: the checkpoint interface maximum would be about 2.29, not below one. Actual evolved maxima must be measured. The chosen halfdt is a bounded sensitivity diagnostic, not a guaranteed stable timestep or a universal CFL acceptance argument.

mass_evidence.spatial_calibration: Four examined cell maps at .668/.938/.972/1.064 sum to their native water and air errors within 1e−12 kg/s. Cell values are already kg/s; no volume multiplication was used.
mass_evidence.distribution: At 1.064 absolute water-cell residual sums are 14.7883 kg/s in the core, 1.4380 in outlet damping and .31254 in inlet forcing. Their signed sums cancel strongly. The future-jet patch x−4.5..−3,z1.5..2.7 contributes 1.03562 kg/s absolute water residual and +.375259 kg/s signed. These measurements do not establish the momentum instability mechanism.
mass_evidence.interpretation: A small global signed mass residual can coexist with an air-velocity failure. The new foil map is not the old no-foil result dominated by one or two outlet cells. Retain native phase and BDF2 diagnostics and the separate physical guards; no budget redefinition.

checkpoint_review.judgement: Suitable as a preserved pre-guard source for the short diagnostic, conditional on fresh source/copy hashes, exact loaded clock, mesh and independent field/force/mass fingerprints. Not an accuracy-certified state.
required_load_checks: Hash checkpoint before copy, verify copied hash and preserve both; never overwrite source.
Confirm loaded physical time .668 and 317277 cells; wave/domain/boundary/AMG/source flags unchanged.
Use the .668 force/mass fingerprint, not the old macro's hardcoded .168 values.
Confirm physical alpha, velocity and mass fields finite before first step; no initialization/reset of wave clock.
Record native and analytic cache-at-load separately. Cached old-step native kg/error values must not be rescaled and treated as a new .5 ms solution.
Require finite analytic gauge/inventory and native phase reports after the first guarded .5 ms step.
Confirm actual .5 ms increments, SECOND_ORDER, ten completed inner iterations, unchanged pressure/VOF AMG tolerances and all physical/resource guards.

timestep_transition.caution: The first .668→.6685 step has a mixed-spacing BDF2 stencil: previous spacing is .001, new spacing is .0005. The constant-step 1.5,−2,.5 formula divided by new dt is not valid for that mixed stencil.
timestep_transition.safe_external_diagnostic: Continue collecting mass/flux and native phase error on every halfstep. If solver-specific variable-step accumulation is not explicitly confirmed, mark only the external first-step BDF2 value unavailable. The constant-step external stencil is valid from the second new increment t=.669 using masses at .668,.6685,.669. This is an explicit stencil-availability distinction, not removal of a failing sample or relaxation of the gate.
timestep_transition.mathematical_variable_BDF2: For h=current dt, r=h/previous_dt: D[M]=(((1+2r)/(1+r))*M_n−(1+r)*M_(n−1)+(r*r/(1+r))*M_(n−2))/h. For r=.5 coefficients are 4/3,−3/2,1/6. Do not assume STAR's transition policy from this algebra alone; confirm before comparing native residual at the first transition.
timestep_transition.actual_dt_units: Post-step native MassConservationError remains kg per completed physical step; divide by actual .0005 s only after that step has been performed.

hypothesis_assessment.hypothesis: Temporal/pressure–VOF coupling sensitivity on the refined free-surface mesh
hypothesis_assessment.support: Local air acceleration grows quickly while phase remains bounded; significant interface CFL and high density contrast are present.
hypothesis_assessment.limit: No inner momentum/pressure convergence or local face-flux sequence establishes this mechanism. Halfdt tests sensitivity, not a unique cause.

hypothesis_assessment.support: Largest interface CFL occurs near x−11.9 mesh join; this is a concrete location for a future cell/face audit.
hypothesis_assessment.limit: The jet is elsewhere. No spatiotemporal perturbation tracking proves the join caused it. Do not infer CFL cell dimensions from polygon bounding boxes or grazing chords.

hypothesis_assessment.support: Old no-foil runs failed near outlet, but that is historical evidence for different geometry/settings.
hypothesis_assessment.limit: Current maximum-speed failure is upstream in core. The previous causal interpretation cannot simply be transferred.

hypothesis_assessment.hypothesis: CPU affinity or utilization caused physical instability
hypothesis_assessment.limit: CPU/GPU activity measurements and process affinity are performance observations. They do not establish a physical/numerical cause.

hypothesis_assessment.hypothesis: VOF clipping or capillary spurious currents
hypothesis_assessment.limit: Bounds [0,1] and low alpha in fast cells do not prove clipping; surface-tension settings and momentum/source balances were not established by this review.

next_test.recommended: From the verified .668 checkpoint, a new short attempt to 1.2 s changing only global dt .001→.0005, with 10 inner iterations and all other numerics/physics/guards unchanged.
next_test.reason: It crosses the original 1.036–1.064 growth interval at the same absolute wave phase and modestly beyond it. Existing r2 provides the matched 1 ms reference; no duplicate baseline is needed.
keep: Native water/air diagnostics on every new halfstep and correctly qualified BDF2 accumulation+flux
Independent force/component and actual/reference gauge reports
Absolute wave clock, checkpoints and original attempt preservation
Explicit separation of exploratory mass exception from physical stability and force accuracy
next_test.compare: Compare all halfsteps for physical/mass maxima, and matched common times for force/gauge differences. Track water/air/interface speed separately and export the jet patch and mesh-join fields around onset. A small change in CD/CL alone cannot clear a speed failure.
next_test.success_meaning: Reaching 1.2 with bounded fields supports only short temporal-stability sensitivity. It does not validate 10–20 wave cycles, free-surface resolution, reflections, timestep accuracy or forces.
next_test.if_failed: Preserve the new failure and return to the same clean checkpoint for a separately justified control. Inspect actual pressure/VOF convergence, local cell/face geometry and momentum flux around the join and jet region before changing another setting. A further dt reduction may be safer than adding uncontrolled parameter changes, but needs a new attempt and remains a diagnostic.
next_test.alternative: No critical evidence currently requires rejecting the bounded halfdt test. A fresh zero-time rebuild would alter more history and is not the clean first comparison. Do not continue the 1.064 failed state, loosen 50 m/s or remove air cells from the speed guard.

old_nofoil_halfdt_distinction.conclusion: R8 disproved that halving dt automatically cures the old no-foil mass-residual spikes in that short window. It did not test the new 317277-cell foil mesh, the core air jet, or times beyond1 s. It neither guarantees nor rules out the present physical-stability benefit. The unchanged .01% review gate still applies.

primary_documentation.title: Choosing a Time-Step
primary_documentation.finding: Time-step choice requires physical time-scale judgment; the guide identifies convective CFL as relevant for advected quantities.

primary_documentation.title: Adaptive Time-Stepping
primary_documentation.finding: The free-surface timestep discussion explicitly identifies interfaces crossing meshes with different CFL and changing velocity fields as relevant situations. This is support for examining timestep sensitivity, not a recommendation here to add adaptive stepping as a simultaneous change.

primary_documentation.title: Interface Sharpening Using Temporal Subcycling
primary_documentation.finding: Installed VOF theory distinguishes second-order BDF2 global accumulation from convection subcycling; substeps=1 does not prove first-order time integration.
